summary: Benchmark 2025-V17 Mortgage Trust filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 solely to disclose that effective September 1, 2026, C-IV Asset Management LLC will become special servicer for The Link mortgage loan and related notes serviced under the Benchmark 2025-V14 pooling and servicing agreement. This trustee-level administrative appointment does not represent a corporate special situation such as an acquisition, spin-off, or restructuring. The filing is a routine current report on servicer changes for securitized commercial mortgage assets. No deal terms, prices, premiums, or board recommendations are stated. The registrant is the depositor, Deutsche Mortgage Asset Receiving Corporation, acting in an administrative capacity. What to watch: any future material servicing actions or loan defaults under the applicable PSA.
